critical_code_review_comments: sendEmailReminder relies on window.location.href = 'mailto:...' which cannot be reliably automated/tested. Consider using an anchor <a href='mailto:...' /> approach or exposing the constructed mailto URL for easier testing.

Phone stripping in /reminders/whatsapp normalizes '06553-222228' to '6553222228' (last 10 digits after removing non-digits then dropping leading 0) and prefixes 91 -> 916553222228. Verify this is intentional (Indian landline STD codes lose their leading 0 which is the common convention).
